/* Generated by build.mjs from VERSION.json. Do not edit the generated sw.js. */
const VERSION = __VERSION__;
const CACHE = 'sami-production-v' + VERSION;
const MEDIA = 'sami-media-v1';
const SHELL = __SHELL__;
const OPTIONAL = __OPTIONAL__;
const scope = new URL('./', self.location.href);
const canonical = name => new URL(name, scope).href;
const shellPaths = new Set(SHELL.map(x => new URL(x, scope).pathname));
const optionalPaths = new Set(OPTIONAL.map(x => new URL(x, scope).pathname));
async function timeoutFetch(request, milliseconds = 3000) {
  const controller = new AbortController();
  const timer = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), milliseconds);
  try { return await fetch(request, {signal: controller.signal}); }
  finally { clearTimeout(timer); }
}
self.addEventListener('install', event => {
  event.waitUntil((async () => {
    const cache = await caches.open(CACHE);
    await Promise.all(SHELL.map(async path => {
      const response = await timeoutFetch(new Request(canonical(path), {cache: 'reload'}), 10000);
      if (!response.ok) throw Error('Required app file unavailable: ' + path);
      if (/\.js(?:\?|$)/.test(path) && /text\/html/.test(response.headers.get('content-type') || '')) throw Error('Invalid script response');
      await cache.put(canonical(path), response);
    }));
    await Promise.allSettled(OPTIONAL.map(async path => {
      const response = await timeoutFetch(canonical(path));
      if (response.ok) await cache.put(canonical(path), response);
    }));
  })());
});
self.addEventListener('message', event => {
  if (event.data?.type === 'ACTIVATE_UPDATE') event.waitUntil(self.skipWaiting());
  if (event.data?.type === 'GET_VERSION') event.ports[0]?.postMessage({version: VERSION});
});
self.addEventListener('activate', event => {
  event.waitUntil((async () => {
    const names = await caches.keys();
    await Promise.all(names.filter(name => name.startsWith('sami-production-v') && name !== CACHE).map(name => caches.delete(name)));
    await self.clients.claim();
  })());
});
async function navigation(request) {
  const cache = await caches.open(CACHE);
  const cached = await cache.match(canonical('./index.html'));
  try {
    const response = await timeoutFetch(request);
    if (!response.ok) throw Error('Navigation unavailable');
    const text = await response.clone().text();
    if (!text.includes('data-sami-version="' + VERSION + '"')) {
      self.registration.update().catch(() => {});
      if (cached) return cached;
      return new Response('SAMI is updating. Close this window and reopen it.', {status:503,headers:{'Content-Type':'text/plain'}});
    }
    await cache.put(canonical('./index.html'), response.clone());
    return response;
  } catch {
    return cached || new Response('SAMI is not available offline yet. Open it once with a connection.', {status:503,headers:{'Content-Type':'text/plain'}});
  }
}
async function shell(request, url) {
  const wanted = url.searchParams.get('v') || VERSION;
  const name = 'sami-production-v' + wanted;
  const cache = await caches.open(name);
  const key = canonical('./' + url.pathname.slice(scope.pathname.length));
  const hit = await cache.match(key, {ignoreSearch:true});
  if (hit) return hit;
  if (wanted !== VERSION) return new Response('Close and reopen SAMI to load matching app files.', {status:503});
  try {
    const response = await timeoutFetch(request);
    if (response.ok && !(/\.js$|\.css$/.test(url.pathname) && /text\/html/.test(response.headers.get('content-type')||''))) {
      await cache.put(key, response.clone()); return response;
    }
    return response.ok ? new Response('',{status:502}) : response;
  } catch { return new Response('', {status:503, statusText:'App file unavailable offline'}); }
}
async function media(request, url) {
  const cache = await caches.open(MEDIA), key = new URL(url.href); key.search = '';
  let response = await cache.match(key.href);
  if (!response) {
    try {
      const headers = new Headers(request.headers); headers.delete('range');
      response = await fetch(new Request(request,{headers}));
      if (response.status === 200) {
        try { await cache.put(key.href, response.clone()); const keys=await cache.keys(); for (const k of keys.slice(0,Math.max(0,keys.length-24))) await cache.delete(k); } catch {}
      }
    } catch { return new Response('',{status:503}); }
  }
  const range = request.headers.get('range');
  if (!range || response.status !== 200) return response;
  const match = /^bytes=(\d*)-(\d*)$/.exec(range);
  if (!match) return new Response('',{status:416});
  const buffer = await response.arrayBuffer(), length = buffer.byteLength;
  let start = match[1] ? +match[1] : Math.max(0,length-(+match[2]||length));
  let end = match[1] && match[2] ? Math.min(+match[2],length-1) : length-1;
  if (start>end || start>=length) return new Response('',{status:416,headers:{'Content-Range':'bytes */'+length}});
  return new Response(buffer.slice(start,end+1),{status:206,headers:{'Content-Type':response.headers.get('content-type')||'audio/mpeg','Content-Range':`bytes ${start}-${end}/${length}`,'Accept-Ranges':'bytes','Content-Length':String(end-start+1)}});
}
self.addEventListener('fetch',event=>{
  const request=event.request,url=new URL(request.url);
  if(request.method!=='GET'||url.origin!==scope.origin||!url.pathname.startsWith(scope.pathname))return;
  if(request.mode==='navigate'){event.respondWith(navigation(request));return;}
  if(shellPaths.has(url.pathname)||optionalPaths.has(url.pathname)){event.respondWith(shell(request,url));return;}
  if(/\.mp3$/i.test(url.pathname)){event.respondWith(media(request,url));return;}
  event.respondWith(timeoutFetch(request).catch(()=>new Response('',{status:503})));
});
